software_development: Build or change software: tests-first, stack patterns (Python/Go/Rust/React…), APIs, databases, containers.
data_analysis: Work with data and judge AI output: SQL, stats, charts, and evals.
rag_evaluation: Measure a RAG or retrieval system. Scores search and answers separately.
product_management: Plan product work: PRDs, roadmaps, prioritization, and go-to-market.
application_security: Find and fix app vulnerabilities, and write secure code.
frontend_design: Build and polish web interfaces: layout, accessibility, motion, design systems.
web_research: Research a topic online and synthesize a cited answer.
release_review: Final gate before shipping: review, verify, confirm it's ready.
bug_fixing: Find and fix a specific bug fast. Root-cause debugging, no ceremony.
code_simplification: Cut over-engineering. Find and delete what you don't need.
content_writing: Write and edit prose: copy, articles, docs, and UX text.
production_engineering: Ship production-grade systems: architecture, security, compliance, deploy, and operate.
test_engineering: Test software end to end: strategy, unit, e2e, regression, and quality gates.
